channel.title: MailHub
channel.description: Updates for MailHub, the Mac mail app.

item.title: Version 0.5.1
item.description:
MailHub 0.5.1

Security improvements following an independent review of 0.5.0.

  • Risky actions now ask in a native Mac window before they happen: sending an email MailHub warned about, weakening a security setting, filters that delete or archive mail, the vacation reply, Send mail as addresses, removing an account, and moving many conversations to Trash.
  • The signature and vacation reply editors clean what you paste into them.
  • Hidden text in a quoted message is no longer included when you reply or forward.
  • Sender checks are stricter.
  • When you add your first account on a device, MailHub asks whether to share sign-ins between your own Mac and iPhone through iCloud Keychain. Nothing is shared unless you choose Share.
  • Attachment names with unusual characters or encodings are now shown and saved correctly.
  • Fixed: a long conversation no longer jumps up while you type a reply at the end of it.
  • Fixed: Settings, Accounts no longer flashes a large account picture or redraws every time an account syncs.
  • The push server for iPhone alerts is hardened, and the Google notices it receives are stored only in the EU.
